status: exploratory (not pre-registered), analyses of the final v5 run
rescore_reason: the final run saved its verifier cache before scoring UA-DETRAC; those calls were re-scored with the same verifier (no labels) and every per-sequence alarm count matched the final run

with_lead_time.note_detected_among_them: 0 by construction: the 60 s cooldown follows the alarm

short_lead_time.note_detected_among_them: 0 by construction: the 60 s cooldown follows the alarm

pre_impact_alarm_timing.reading: observed shares above the null would indicate alarms concentrating just before impact; shares near the null mean the short armed interval explains the timing

false_alarms_armed.definition: Poisson alarms at rate lambda while armed; after each alarm the camera is silent for 60 s; long-run rate = lambda / (1 + lambda * cooldown)

temporal_constant_guess.source: median impact time of ACCIDENT train/val clips (no holdout information)

suggested_phase10_ranges.detection_rate_basis: non-US Wilson lower bound to overall Wilson upper bound; overall 0.609 (0.584-0.633), non-US 0.366 (0.304-0.432)
suggested_phase10_ranges.false_alarm_basis: UA-DETRAC lower bound to ACCIDENT pre-impact upper bound, both per armed hour; the simulator applies the cooldown
